claim_ceiling: Exact declared carrier and scoped-function behavior plus supplied finite hypothetical models; no accepted decoding map, actual context, operational ownership, permission, fidelity or whole proof.

excluded_effects: Shared schema mechanics, generators, validators, fixtures, and receipts remain evidence and local tooling; they are not admitted runtimes or implementation bindings.
No operational context, language, map, migration, lineage, or capability-instance owner is bound.
No Bounded Context, Coordination Context, Ubiquitous Language, Context Map, Capability Instance, Context Migration Manifest, or Context Lineage Record instance is created or admitted.
No migration execution, implementation authority, publication, deployment, external effect, or stable release is authorized or performed.
No Coordination Context instance is admitted, created, migrated, or activated.
No Product, Project, Goal, Bounded Context, owner, consumer, implementation, or runtime is activated.
No Relation Kind, ordered endpoint pair, qualifier schema, Typed Relation, or relation projection is admitted.
No Coordination Context/v1 bytes are rewritten or deleted.
No Artifact Type other than the exact Coordination Context/v2 successor is admitted.
No ordinary Artifact Type instance other than the exact integrated Governed Model instance is admitted.
No Typed Relation instance or example is admitted.
No Ontology Node, Ontology Edge, semantic event, or governance event instance is created.
No consumer, Agent, Session, implementation, service, or runtime is activated.
No migration, cutover, publication, release, deployment, or external effect occurs.
No historical artifact, decision, or registry snapshot bytes are rewritten.

source_coordinate_correspondence.rationale: Stable identity and record revision need separate accepted maps.
Resolve exactly one Product; a scalar is a nomination.
Map purpose and stability; nonempty text is insufficient.
Resolve consumers; schema minimum one is a carrier policy.
Interpret uses and suitability; schema minimum one is a carrier policy.
Map statement and exclusions to the governed scope.
Resolve policies and distinguish nomination from enforcement.
Resolve explicit separately owned versions; an empty list is allowed.
Resolve nominated principal, role and bounded authority.
Historical posture and current lifecycle state are distinct proposed maps.
Authenticate history; an empty list is not proof of persistence.
Resolve accountable handler and process.
v1 permits omission; v2 requires explicit null for absence.
Independent optional anchor with the same representation distinction.
Resolve exact referenced boundary versions before mapping their separately nominated semantic owners.
Select authentic before state; fixtures are examples.
Desired state must remain independent of successor nomination.
Materiality is not every unequal purpose string.
Retain presence and reference identity separately.
Retain presence and reference identity separately.
Resolve distinct matching successor; the package compares anchors without a materiality parameter.
Select an authenticated source-view before record without importing anchor-change meaning.
Select after record and retain durable identity independently of real view suitability.
No direct source-view snapshot coordinate is selected from these carriers.
Policy-list changes and view changes require an explicit correspondence.

unresolved_consumer_findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner with coordination, boundary, identity, lifecycle, source-policy and relation owners

unresolved_consumer_findings.issue: Lifecycle strings, history arrays and nonempty owner or challenge references do not prove actual durability, operational ownership, history authenticity or accountable handling.

unresolved_consumer_findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner with coordination, boundary, identity, lifecycle, source-policy and relation owners
